name: Vitre Workspaces
description: Workspace switches as a glass depth slide: the workspace you leave steps back and dims while the next one slides in and settles on the Vitre spring, with a soft lit edge between the two. Keys, the three- or four-finger swipe and the Dock all use it; the fingers move it one to one, it reverses under them, and on lift-off it carries on at their speed. The top bar and the Dock stay put. Reduced motion gives a short cross-fade. Setting style = stock gives GNOME's own slide back.
